research_rationale: EO 13868 (signed 2019-04-10, 84 FR 15495-15499), read in full from the held FR text, directs agency actions on energy infrastructure: Clean Water Act section 401 guidance and rules (sec. 3), LNG safety and rail-transport rules (sec. 4), a Labor Department review of ERISA data and proxy guidance (sec. 5), rights-of-way renewals (sec. 6), reports (secs. 7-9) and general provisions (sec. 10). The machine own-term kinds (condition, fixed_term, report_deadline, sunset_date) are all misleading: they pick up 60-, 100-, 120- and 180-day periods, '13 months' and '1 year' deadlines, and the word 'sunset' in sec. 6, which describes expiring rights-of-way grants issued by agencies, not an end of the order. None of these is an end and the order has no sunset or termination clause. No clause's first end needs a report date, so the order is not blocked on the report-deadline question. EO 13990 (86 FR 7037-7043, read in full; reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_13990.json) sec. 7(a) revokes it, effective on signing, 2021-01-20. The dossier lists no missing provision; a by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts finds EO 13868 named only in EO 13990. EO 14148 and EO 14154 (2025) revoke EO 13990 but name none of the six orders and reinstate nothing. Inventory correction: the dossier splits the tail of sec. 3(d) into a separate fragment clause 'sec3-c-dup2' and labels sec. 3(b)(i) and (ii) 'sec3-i-dup2' and 'sec3-i-ii-dup2'; inventory_overrides merge the fragment into sec3-d and rename the two spans sec3-b-i and sec3-b-ii. All other spans are copied unchanged, so 36 clauses cover the operative text from sec. 1 through sec. 10(c) with no gap or overlap.
